title: Taste and Sea | 128 Tupelo | Seaside Vacation Rental – Dune Vacation Rentals
meta_description: Stay at Taste & Sea, a 3-bed, 3.5-bath Seaside vacation rental with screened porches, a sunset-view tower, and elegant coastal décor. Reserve here now!
description_expanded:
Taste & Sea | Seaside, FL

128 Tupelo Street Santa Rosa Beach, FL 32459

"Taste & Sea" has been beautifully remodeled from top to bottom and is the perfect location for your Seaside vacation! This luxurious cottage is located on peaceful Tupelo street and is only a quick walk to the adult pool, fitness center, family pool and tennis facility. The home is decorated in a coastal luxury style, featuring creamy white walls, gorgeous wood floors and comfortable furnishings with pops of coastal blues and greens.

The living space of Taste & Sea is on the first floor. The kitchen features all new appliances surrounded by creamy white cabinets and has a quaint little breakfast nook perfect for enjoying a cup of coffee and working your daily crossword puzzle. The dining area is located just across from the kitchen and has a large dining table with seating for eight. The living area is spacious and open and has two large sofas and two chairs for your family to enjoy relaxing and spending time catching up with each other or catching the big game on the 55 inch HDTV. One of your family's favorite places to spend time is sure to be the spacious, screened in porch located just off of the living space. The porch has wonderful furniture and faces Tupelo street and always has a salty breeze blowing through.

All three bedrooms are located on the second floor of the home. The master bedroom is located on the front of the home and has access to a wonderful screened in porch that overlooks Tupelo street. The porch is perfect for relaxing in the cool breeze that blows across the porch. The master bedroom features a king sized bed and has an ensuite bathroom. The ensuite has been completely remodeled and has double vanities and a deep soaking tub/shower combo, as well as a walk in closet. Just down the hallway are the two guest bedrooms, both with king sized beds. The first king bedroom has an ensuite bathroom which features a single vanity and a walk-in shower with beautiful tile work. The second king guest room also has an ensuite bathroom with a single vanity and deep soaking tub/shower combo. Located just across the hallway from the master bedroom is a spiral staircase which leads to a viewing tower with bench seating and overlooks the town of Seaside. The breeze is wonderful and is the perfect place to watch the sunset in the evenings. You can even catch glimpes of the emerald green waters.

**If you need space for a few more people, Taste & Sea has a guest cottage available for rental. "Sea Shack" is an adorable, two bedroom property that will sleep 5 people and is located just behind the main home.

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

Home Highlights

Sleeps 6

3 Bedrooms

3 1/2 Baths

2,422 Square Feet

3rd Floor Viewing Tower

Parking Available for 2 Cars

First Floor

- Welcoming front porches with beautiful seating area

- Living room with plenty of seating for the entire group

- Half bath

- Kitchen with high-end appliances and breakfast nook

- Dining area with seating for 8

Second Floor

- King master bedroom with flat screen TV and a master bath with double vanities, and soaking tub/shower combo

- King bedroom with ensuite bath with walk-in shower

- King bedroom with ensuite bath with a soaking tub/shower combo

- Seating area with TV

- Laundry room

- Large porch area with seating overlooks Tupelo Street

- Spiral staircase to the 3rd floor tower

Third Floor

- Outdoor viewing tower with 360 degree views of Seaside

Additional

- Parking for 2 vehicles

- Golf cart rentals are not allowed in Seaside.

- No events, such as wedding receptions and other large gatherings are allowed. Only people sleeping in the home are allowed on this property. If violated, double cleaning fees, as well as other possible fees, will apply.

- No pet home. Per the signed Rental Agreement, any violation of the no pet policy will result in immediate eviction, plus additional clean charges.

- No smoking home. Per the signed Rental Agreement, any violation of the No Smoking policy will result in immediate eviction, plus additional cleaning charges.

- Can be rented with the guest cottage "Sea Shack". 2 bedrooms, Sleeps 5

- Seaside Amenity Fees Include: Seaside Parking Passes (2), Wristbands for Beach Access, and Access to the Community Swimming Pools and Tennis Courts.

Reservation/Booking Policy

- Minimum Age: All properties require a minimum of one adult over the age of 26 be staying at the property throughout the rental term.

- A 50% deposit is due at the time of booking

- Except for a $250 cancellation fee, deposits are fully refundable if cancellations are given 60 days prior to the arrival date

- Balance of payment is due 60 days prior to arrival date

- Check-in begins at 4:00 PM and check-out is by 10:00 AM

- Cleaning: Reservations made for more than 12 nights require a full clean during your stay. This will be added onto your total when checking out. Reservations for less than 12 days, have the option to add a mid-stay clean onto your reservation.
